clearedSpotChecks.check: Cycle 30 critic lead on the AccountChange arm of Tempo's rollback: after a reverted frame that moved value, does every balance return to its pre-frame word, for the balances the PoolManager settles against?
clearedSpotChecks.note: I reran research/network-risk/cycles/031/stablecoin-l1.work/scripts/tip20_rollback.py against https://rpc.mainnet.tempo.xyz on 2026-11-27 (web3_clientVersion tempo/v1.19.1-a9d6748). I read the harness first. The inner frame transfers 1,000,000 pathUSD from the PoolManager address and reverts when the mode word is 3. With the reverting inner frame the PoolManager balance was 19,999,506,794 before and after and 0xb0b held 0. With the returning inner frame the balance fell to 19,998,506,794 and 0xb0b held 1,000,000. The base figure differs from the research file's 19,999,496,692 because the live balance moved between runs; the deltas match. An eth_call with value 1 to settle() (selector 0x11da60b4) returned error -32003 'value transfer not allowed'. In the code, _settle credits msg.value only when no currency is synced (src/PoolManager.sol:353-354) and otherwise reverts on nonzero value and credits balance minus synced reserves (src/PoolManager.sol:355-361); take debits the caller before Currency.transfer (src/PoolManager.sol:291-296, src/types/Currency.sol:40-73). No ordinary account can create a positive native delta without msg.value, so the native branch of transfer cannot pay out funds that were never settled. One limit stands: the eth_call checks the RPC path, and I did not read whether an internal CALL with value is refused the same way. It does not matter here, because native liquidity cannot enter the PoolManager.
